Spray Dried Litchi Powder for Beverage, Dairy and Confectionery Makers

Tradenest Naturals supplies spray dried litchi powder for manufacturers who want a reliable tropical fruit flavor. Spray drying captures the floral aroma and gentle sweetness of ripe lychees in a fine, dry powder. It is used in drinks, desserts, dairy products and sweets. Every batch is made to a written specification, so the flavor and color you approve are the flavor and color you receive.

Processing Method

Ripe lychee fruit is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. The fruit is peeled and pitted, and the juice is extracted for a concentrated flavor. The juice is then atomized into a hot air chamber. Its water evaporates almost instantly, and the fine powder is collected at the base of the dryer. Short drying time helps keep the fruit's delicate aroma and light cream color. The powder is then sieved to an even particle size and packed in moisture-resistant bags straight after drying. Full composition details, including any drying carrier, are listed on the product specification sheet.

Why Choose Our Litchi Powder?

Fruit flavor can vary a lot from one supplier or season to the next. Our bulk litchi powder is produced to the same 80-100 mesh and below 5% moisture standard on every run. It dissolves readily, so it is easy to add to drinks and liquid mixes without lumps. Beverage and confectionery makers alike find it simple to work with. In sealed packs it keeps for 18-24 months, which helps reduce waste and simplify stock planning. That steadiness is why international brands use us as a litchi powder supplier.

Versatile Applications in Food Production

Our wholesale lychee powder is used across many sectors. Beverage makers use it in juices, smoothies, iced teas and flavored waters. Confectioners add a tropical note to gummies, hard candies and fillings. Bakers use it in pastries, cake mixes and creams. Dairy producers add it to yogurt, ice cream and flavored milk. Because the flavor is concentrated, a small dose has a clear effect. It also pairs well with rose, coconut and other tropical fruit flavors in blended products.

Quality Assurance and Compliance

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI registered food business and an IEC registered exporter. Our team checks moisture, mesh size and color on every batch before it is packed. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Our natural litchi powder bulk shipments carry batch numbers, so every lot can be traced back to its production run. We also support importers with the export documents needed for smooth customs clearance. If your quality team has a supplier questionnaire, we are happy to complete it.

Frequently Asked Questions for B2B Buyers

What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried litchi powder? The MOQ is 5 Kg. Larger orders receive better pricing, and small pilot lots are welcome. Contact our sales team for a quote. What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, purity)? The standard grade is spray dried, 80-100 mesh, with moisture below 5%. Composition is stated on the specification sheet. If you need a different particle size, please ask. What are the packaging and shelf-life options? Options include 25 kg bulk bags, stand-up pouches and OEM or private label packing. Shelf life is 18-24 months when stored sealed in a cool, dry place. What is the lead time and how do I request a sample? Lead time depends on order volume and packing. Samples are available on request. To ask for a sample or a formal quote, use our website inquiry form.
